# nebius_vpc_v1_default_network Data Source

Retrieves the default network and its default subnet for a specified project.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `parent_id` (String) ID of the parent project.

### Optional

- `network` (Attributes) :

   #### Inner value description
   
   Defines a Network, which serves as a virtual representation of a traditional LAN
   within a cloud environment.
   Networks facilitate communication between subnets. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--network))
- `subnet` (Attributes) :

   #### Inner value description
   
   Defines a Subnet, a segment of a network used for more granular control and management.
   Subnet uses pools to organize address space. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subnet))

<a id="nestedatt--network--status"></a>
### Nested Schema for `network.status`

Optional:

- `default` (Boolean) Indicates whether this is the project's default network.
- `default_route_table_id` (String) ID of the network's default route table.
- `state` (String) :

   Current state of the network.
   
   #### Supported values
   
   Enumeration of possible states of the network.
   Possible values:
   
   - `STATE_UNSPECIFIED` - Default state, unspecified.
   - `CREATING` - Network is being created.
   - `READY` - Network is ready for use.
   - `DELETING` - Network is being deleted.

<a id="nestedatt--subnet--spec"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subnet.spec`

Optional:

- `ipv4_private_pools` (Attributes) :

   Private IPv4 address pools for this subnet.
   If unspecified, pools from the associated network are used. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subnet--spec--ipv4_private_pools))
- `ipv4_public_pools` (Attributes) :

   Public IPv4 address pools for this subnet.
   If unspecified, pools from the associated network are used. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subnet--spec--ipv4_public_pools))
- `network_id` (String) ID of the network this subnet belongs to.
- `route_table_id` (String) :

   ID of the route table to associate with the subnet.
   If unspecified, the network's default route table is used.

<a id="nestedatt--subnet--spec--ipv4_private_pools"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subnet.spec.ipv4_private_pools`

Optional:

- `pools` (Attributes List) :

   List of private IPv4 CIDR blocks for this subnet.
   Must not overlap with other resources in the network
   Must be empty if `use_network_pools` is true. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subnet--spec--ipv4_private_pools--pools))
- `use_network_pools` (Boolean) :

   If true, inherit private IPv4 pools from the network. Defaults to true.
   Must be false if `pools` is specified.

<a id="nestedatt--subnet--spec--ipv4_private_pools--pools"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subnet.spec.ipv4_private_pools.pools`

Optional:

- `cidrs` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subnet--spec--ipv4_private_pools--pools--cidrs))

<a id="nestedatt--subnet--spec--ipv4_private_pools--pools--cidrs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subnet.spec.ipv4_private_pools.pools.cidrs`

Optional:

- `cidr` (String) :

   A CIDR block (e.g., "10.1.2.0/24") or a prefix length (e.g., "/24").
   If prefix length is specified, the CIDR block will be auto-allocated
   from the network's available space.
- `max_mask_length` (Number) Maximum mask length for an allocation from this block. Defaults to /32 for IPv4.
- `state` (String) :

   Controls provisioning of IP addresses from the CIDR block. Defaults to AVAILABLE.
   
   #### Supported values
   
   Controls provisioning of IP addresses from this pool to other pools
   or allocations. Defaults to AVAILABLE.
   Possible values:
   
   - `STATE_UNSPECIFIED` - Not used, mandated by the protocol.
   - `AVAILABLE` - Default state. Provision of the IP addresses from this CIDR block is allowed.
   - `DISABLED` - Provision of the IP addresses from this CIDR block is denied.

<a id="nestedatt--subnet--status"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subnet.status`

Optional:

- `default` (Boolean) Indicates whether this is the network's default subnet.
- `ipv4_private_cidrs` (List of String, Deprecated) :

   CIDR blocks.
   Deprecated: Use `ipv4_private_pools.cidrs` instead.
- `ipv4_private_pools` (Attributes List) Private IPv4 pools available for allocations in this subnet. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subnet--status--ipv4_private_pools))
- `ipv4_public_cidrs` (List of String, Deprecated) :

   CIDR blocks.
   Deprecated: Use `ipv4_public_pools.cidrs` instead.
- `ipv4_public_pools` (Attributes List) Public IPv4 pools available for allocations in this subnet. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subnet--status--ipv4_public_pools))
- `route_table` (Attributes) :

   Information about the route table associated with this subnet.
   Can be either a custom route table or the network's default route table. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subnet--status--route_table))
- `state` (String) :

   Current state of the subnet.
   
   #### Supported values
   
   Enumeration of possible states of the subnet.
   Possible values:
   
   - `STATE_UNSPECIFIED` - Default state, unspecified.
   - `CREATING` - Subnet is being created.
   - `READY` - Subnet is ready for use.
   - `DELETING` - Subnet is being deleted.

### Nested Schema for `subnet.status.ipv4_private_pools`

Optional:

<a id="nestedatt--subnet--status--ipv4_public_pools"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subnet.status.ipv4_public_pools`

Optional:

- `cidrs` (List of String) CIDR blocks sourced from this pool.

<a id="nestedatt--subnet--status--route_table"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subnet.status.route_table`

Optional:

- `default` (Boolean) :

   Indicates whether this is the network's default route table.
   If true, this is the default route table inherited from the network.
   If false, this is a custom route table explicitly associated with the subnet via spec.
- `id` (String) ID of the route table.
